reason: Checked every path. Entries: sky_check is only reached by JSR from sky.6502:244 (listing &A2A9 -> &A325); nothing in src or tools names its inner labels or label+N. sky_row leaves X alone and returns A = sky_skip with Z from it, so the LDA #0 and the part path's LDA sky_skip can go. sky_geom gives rn 1..8 (row 0: L+1; rows above: 8; top: 1..8), so skip is 0..7. A whole row has rn=8 and rt=7: row 0 only when L=7, the others rt=7. Every sky_ry/sky_rc is a multiple of 8 (ytop = 8*(d2-d1), rl is a multiple of 8 and so is rc = -rl), and with 14 image columns Y is at most 111. So Y = 8k+7 < 128 and the unrolled ORA reads the same 8(k+1) bytes in the same order as the original. ORA #0/BEQ sets Z from the OR exactly as TAX/BNE did. Part path: C=1 comes back from sky_row, but the two ASLs clear it (skip <= 7), so ADC gives 5s with C=0, and SBC #4 gives 5(s-1) with C=1. The BRA offset enters slot s-1, which leaves 8-s = n slots of LDA/BNE dirty/DEY, the same bytes in the same order as the original loop. C stays 1 into SBC sky_skip because the slots never touch C. When BPL is taken there was no borrow, so C=1 again; a borrow leaves Y at 249 or more, which is negative, and that exits as before. X is now the row all through, and next_row's INX gives the same X the reload from sky_q did. Exits: CLC/RTS and SEC/RTS, same stack. The only caller (fall/draw) reads only C, not A/X/Y. Not storing sky_q (&E0) is safe: its only readers, sky_draw and sky_zero (reached through sky_erase_old), store it first, and no other symbol aliases &E0. The self-modified BRA operand is in bank 4 sideways RAM (&A3xx), which is writable, and irq1_handler never runs or reads sky_check, so an interrupt between the STA and the BRA changes nothing.
